title: NEW+1 (v2) files read by OLD build

legacy_observed.behaviour: OLD loads v2 as if current, trades on it and writes state.json still labelled v2 with OLD semantics (version laundering)

violates: D1 future schema: abort, state+backup byte-identical

nc02_required.R-GEN-MONOTONIC: every store write carries (generation, writer_build, format_version, min_reader_version); a reader that sees a generation written by a newer build, or a lower generation than the highest it has seen (rollback/stale copy), aborts read-only (R-ABORT-RO)
nc02_required.R-ABORT-RO: start-up aborts before ANY write to the store: every input file byte-identical after the attempt (sha256 equal), no rename, no .bak rotation, no settings write; the refusal is reported out-of-band (process exit code + boot incident log outside the store)
